FM05.reasoning: The data contains a temporal component ('Agreement Date'), but the agent uses a random train/validation split rather than a time-based split, which can introduce look-ahead bias.

other_failure_modes.name: Test-set dependent feature dropping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent identifies and drops constant columns within the test set independently, then subsets the training set to only include columns present in both. This drops potentially useful features from the training set simply because they happen to lack variance in the specific test sample provided.

summary: The agent provides a generally robust solution with proper target handling, feature engineering for dates, early stopping on a validation set, and retraining on the full dataset. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the data by using a random train-validation split (risking look-ahead bias), and it incorrectly drops features from the training set if they happen to be constant in the test set.
